description: Extract a page's structured metadata: Open Graph, Twitter cards, canonical URL, language and JSON-LD. When to use: you need the title/description/author/image of a page, or JSON-LD structured data for a product/article, without reading the whole page. Do not use: when you need the page text (use web_fetch) or a screenshot (use web_screenshot). Returns: {ok, url, final_url, title, description, image, site_name, type, canonical, lang, jsonld[], cached, took_ms, _metering}. Metered: shares the web free bucket (100 calls/day per IP shared by all web tools), then 1 credit per call over x402 - there is no API key.
name: web_metadata
title: Web Metadata
